summary: Kit Storybook plays find a tooltip through its anchor's aria-describedby with one shared tooltipFor helper, and assert its role, exact accessible name and visibility. Composer tooltip plays open tooltips with keyboard focus. HumanTime gains an optional hoverDelay, used at 0 by its strict plays, and points its time element to the tooltip while the tooltip is mounted.

compatibility.detail: Additive: HumanTime accepts optional hoverDelay, which defaults to the previous 400 ms. While its tooltip is open, the time element adds aria-describedby that points to the tooltip. The tooltip text equals the existing aria-description, so the accessible description stays the same.
